title: Media object
summary: Fixed image next to text that wraps: flex-shrink: 0 and min-width: 0.
explanation: The image must never shrink, so it gets flex-shrink: 0. The text column gets flex: 1 to take the rest.
Flex items default to min-width: auto, which stops them shrinking below their content. min-width: 0 on the text lets long words wrap or truncate instead of overflowing.
tryThis: Remove flex-shrink: 0 and narrow the preview to 375px.

children.text: The image keeps its size while this text takes the remaining space and wraps onto as many lines as it needs.
